title: Elodie and the Bakery
author: Sebastian Nystrom
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
